name: Charlotte Open Fall 2014

venue.name: [Myers Park High School](http://schools.cms.k12.nc.us/myersparkHS/Pages/Default.aspx)
venue.details: The competition will be held in the Cafeteria

information: Registration fee is $12 when registering before the day of the competition. Day of registration fee is $30, paid at the door. The competition will be held inside the Myers Park High School Cafeteria.  Food is allowed inside. There are restaurants near the venue where competitors may get food during lunch.
